decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extensions hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the east wall of the extensions hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - Details of external brickwork, pointing, mortar, and bonding shall be in accordance with the advice given in Technical Note 1 of the Bedford Park Society's handbook for residents and architects.

Condition : 6 - Before the installation of the sloping glass roof hereby approved, detailed drawings, including appropriate cross sections, and any material changes required for Building Regulations purposes to show how the junctions between the glass roof, the flat roof and the walls will be achieved shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The installation shall be undertaken in accordance with the approved plans
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension and a first floor rear extension to house
